name: IDE Context Server
description: WebSocket-based IDE context server. Creates an HTTP server on a random 127.0.0.1 port with a WebSocket server overlay. Implements JSON-RPC 2.0 'initialize' handshake (protocolVersion 2025-11-25). Broadcasts 'selection_changed' events to all connected clients when editor state changes. Writes lock files to .cockpit/ide.lock, %USERPROFILE%/.claude/ide/{port}.lock, and {xdgData}/opencode/ide/{port}.lock for IDE protocol discovery by AI agents. Singleton exported as 'ideServer'.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Start HTTP+WS server on random port, write lock files

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Close all WS clients, shut down server, remove lock files

methods.name: updateEditorState
methods.description: Broadcast selection_changed to all connected clients

methods.name: getPort
methods.description: Return current server port (0 if not running)

methods.name: getLockPaths
methods.description: Return paths of all written lock files

lifecycle.destroyed_by: main.ts app window-all-closed or workspace switch stop()
